name: PIANO FORTE
source:
Main character is an aspiring pianist. He starts his career in a different province and now comes to visit his home town. His family has always lived heart-to-heart with the neighbor family. This is a story of protagonist cheerful time spent in both families during his visit.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
立志成为钢琴家的主人公在外地开启了职业生涯，如今重返故乡探亲。主人公一家与隔壁邻家素来亲如一家，本作便讲述了他返乡期间在两家人身边度过的温馨欢乐时光。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
